items.headline: Anthropic files to go public with an IPO filing
items.summary: On October 26 Anthropic, the company behind Claude, filed a registration statement (called an S-1) with the SEC for a proposed initial public offering, meaning it plans to sell shares to the public for the first time.
items.why_it_matters: If you build your business on Claude, this is a sign of a company with long-term staying power, though a public company may eventually face pressure on pricing and plans, so keep your workflows portable.
